title: Defying Heaven's Law
summary: Ouyang Zi, the Cloud Sky Sect's best alchemist, finally refines the grade-six Origin Recovery Pill, while Wang Lin spends three years building restrictions in the valley to face the tribulation that Heaven's Law will send. Li Muwan forms her Nascent Soul, but a hand of Heaven's Law comes down, her body dies, and her Nascent Soul is about to be erased. Wang Lin's clone and his Ancient God main body merge, and with the sun and moon in the sky together he fights a fist of Heaven's Law until it backs off. Wan'er's Nascent Soul survives and goes back to sleep, and Wang Lin expects Heaven's Law to return in nineteen years when it wakes. He swears that one day he will replace Heaven's Law and make it kneel.
